semantics.owner_rule: #I resolves to the canonical Input family/registry.
semantics.dynamic_rule: Dynamic input-source instances may be surfaced through #INPUT:* according to the dynamic input namespace contract.
semantics.adapter_rule: Input ownership remains separate from Adapter translation/mount semantics.
semantics.payload_rule: Input values remain inert until explicit operations consume them.
semantics.identity_rule: Input source identity is explicit and independent from transport/file path.
semantics.authority_rule: Input presence or writeability does not grant operation authority.

invariants.rule: Each reserved runtime root resolves to one explicit semantic owner/family; the root itself does not create new authority.
